(Cheyenne, Wyoming) | college = *[[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] (2021–2023) *[[Utah Utes men's basketball|Utah]] (2023–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | career_start = 2025 | years1 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025]]–present | team1 = [[Memphis Hustle]] | years2 = {{nbay|2025|end}} | team2 = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | highlights = }} '''Lawson Lovering''' (born May 9, 2003) is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[Memphis Hustle]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]] and [[Utah Utes men's basketball|Utah Utes]]. ==Career== Lovering played his first two seasons of college basketball for [[University of Colorado|Colorado]], but he eventually entered the transfer portal after his sophomore season, ultimately landing at the [[University of Utah]].{{cite web |last=Rooney |first=Pat |title= Change begins: CU Buffs center Lawson Lovering reportedly headed to transfer portal |url= https://www.denverpost.com/2023/03/22/change-begins-cu-buffs-center-lawson-lovering-reportedly-headed-to-transfer-portal/ |website=denverpost.com|accessdate= February 11, 2026 |date=March 22, 2023}}{{cite web |last=Drew |first=Jay |title= ‘Their system fits me better’: Why Colorado transfer Lawson Lovering picked the Runnin’ Utes |url= https://www.deseret.com/2023/4/7/23672616/utah-runnin-utes-basketball-land-lawson-lovering-transfer-from-colorado-buffaloes/ |website=deseret.com|accessdate= February 11, 2026 |date=April 7, 2023}} Undrafted out of college, Lovering landed with the [[Memphis Hustle]] of the [[NBA G League]], where he averaged 8.9 points and 7.8 rebounds in 13 games. On February 9, 2026, he was signed to a 10-day contract by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]], making his NBA debut on February 11.{{cite web|title= Grizzlies Sign Lawson Lovering to 10-Day Contract |url= https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-lawson-lovering-to-10-day-contract |website=NBA.com|date=February 9, 2026|access-date=February 11, 2026}} In his debut, Lovering recorded three points, four rebounds and two steals in 18 minutes of action.{{cite web |title= Central grad Lawson Lovering makes NBA debut |url= https://www.wyomingnews.com/wyosports/wyosports/high_school/cheyenne_central/central-grad-lawson-lovering-makes-nba-debut/article_e9d75f81-e30d-42ae-b84d-69e0ca13e393.html
